start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein se kya pasand hai?

turns.line: Mujhe cycling bahut pasand hai! Kal humne colony mein race lagayi, main second aaya
turns.reply: Kabir, race mein colony ke chakkar lagana park ke rounds jaisa hai—har round ki boundary-distance milkar total distance banati hai. Perimeter ke liye aap kya jodenge?
